🔥 शाहरुख खान ने मेटा के शो House of Instagram पर फिल्म King का दूसरा गाना Daddy Cool लॉन्च किया। 🎬 इस इवेंट में उन्होंने Kareena Kapoor Khan के साथ अपनी अपकमिंग फिल्म के इस गाने से पर्दा उठाया और filmmaker Karan Johar के साथ खास बातचीत की। ❤️ शाहरुख ने दिल टूटने पर ज्ञान देते हुए कहा कि टूटे दिल से जिंदगी के लिए जगह बनती है और क्रिएटर्स के लिए देना ही सबसे बड़ी चीज है। 👑 उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि उनका कोई फैंडम नहीं बल्कि प्यार का किंगडम है। 🕺 इवेंट में उन्होंने Om Shanti Om का डायलॉग भी बोला और फैंस के साथ खूब मस्ती की। 🎄 यह फिल्म 24 दिसंबर को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हो रही है और इसमें Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan जैसे कई बड़े कलाकार नजर आएंगे। क्या आप शाहरुख खान की इस नई फिल्म King को देखने के लिए थिएटर्स में जा रहे हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: ‘Don’t have fandom, I have kingdom of love’: Shah Rukh Khan at King song ‘Daddy Cool’ launch
ctx.text:
Superstar Shah Rukh Khan unveiled King’s second song “Daddy Cool” , which features him alongside actor Kareena Kapoor Khan, at Meta’s flagship show House of Instagram on Friday. He also interacted with creators gathered at the event, sat down for a conversation with filmmaker Karan Johar, and shared some words of advice on dealing with heartbreak.
Shah Rukh emphasised on the necessity of a broken heart, as it has more space for life. He advised the creators that for them, giving should be the essence. SRK said: “A broken heart is very important, because a broken heart gives more space for life to walk in. A broken heart learns, teaches, how to love a little. A broken heart will always make you want to give more than take, and for a creator, giving is the essence. With that broken heart or not broken heart, giving is what makes you different every time.”
SRK’s talking about the broken heart is the moment of the day ❤️
#SRK #ShahRukhKhan #TeamShahRukhKhan # Mumbai #King https://t.co/pvLsVq8qEs
— Team Shah Rukh Khan Fan Club (@teamsrkfc) November 27, 2026
Shah Rukh Khan enjoys a humongous fan base around the world. On being asked about his idea of fans and fandom, he shared: “I know a mother would like to have a son like me, a father would like to have a son like me, a man would like to have a brother like me, and a girl would like to have a husband like me, which is not a good thing (jokingly). But somewhere down the line, I feel an attachment to younger people, older people and middle-aged people. I’m extremely fortunate, and I understood that fortune. I realised that fortune very fast. I know this is something beyond my talent, beyond my hard work. It is an attachment that I need to keep giving back to, to be grateful for and to say thank you for. In a sense of service, I never even like to use the words, ‘Oh, I have a fandom.’ I really believe I have a kingdom of love. That’s why they call me ‘King’ with a capital K.”
#King #SRK #ShahRukhKhan #TeamShahRukhKhan #Mumbai https://t.co/n40kXrBNKW
— Team Shah Rukh Khan Fan Club (@teamsrkfc) November 27, 2026
During the event, Shah Rukh Khan recited a dialogue from Om Shanti Om. SRK then watched reels of fans who recreated his song “Tu Mil Jaaye”. He also invited a few fans on stage and shared warm hugs with them. Among them was a fan named Raj, whom Shah Rukh asked to mimic him. Later, in his trademark tongue-in-cheek manner, the actor remarked, “You’ve no idea how good I am at mimicking my own self.”

King marks the second collaboration of Shah Rukh and Siddharth Anand after Pathaan. King also stars Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Deepika Padukone, Anil Kapoor, Jackie Shroff, Rani Mukerji, Jaideep Ahlawat, Arshad Warsi and Raghav Juyal. Produced by Gauri Khan, Anand, and Mamta Anand under Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures, the film is set to hit theatres on December 24. It hits the big screen a week after Avengers: Doomsday
